ConditionalArgument.description: Chooses a value at run time. A Then or Else branch may be {"Std:Omit": true} to leave the member out. One Std:If may nest inside another.

StepDependency.description: A step this step depends on: either the step name, or an object that also names the upstream outcome that starts this step.

JsonGetFunction.description: Reads a value from a JSON file, either a property file of an upstream step or an S3 object.

LineageEntityReference.description: A lineage entity, named by ARN, or by name and type for an entity this step creates.

Arguments.description: Runs an EMR Serverless job on an existing application (ApplicationId) or on a new application the step creates (ApplicationConfig).

ApplicationConfig.description: Members of the EMR Serverless CreateApplication request.

JobConfig.description: Members of the EMR Serverless StartJobRun request, such as executionRoleArn and jobDriver.

ConfigurationOverrides.description: Members of the EMR Serverless ConfigurationOverrides structure.

DeleteAfterRun.description: Delete the application the step created after the job run. Applies with ApplicationConfig.

The SageMaker ImportHubContent request. HubContentDocument is serialized as a JSON string. When HubContentVersion is omitted, each execution imports a new version.
The Amazon Athena StartQueryExecution request. QueryString must be a literal string.

Runs the body steps once for each item in IterableItems.

IterableItems.description: A non-empty literal list, or a reference that resolves to a list at run time.

Selector.description: Picks one iteration, exposed as the Selected property.

ForEachBody.description: The steps to run for each item. Condition, Fail and ForEach steps are not allowed here.

^[A-Za-z0-9\\-_]{1,128}$.description: A literal string, or a Get or Std:Join that references only pipeline parameters.
